title: processing.agg_predict.agg_predict
---



```python
processing.agg_predict.agg_predict(predictions, weights=None)
```

Aggregates multiple prediction columns into a single combined prediction series.

The combination is a weighted sum of the prediction columns. If no weights are provided,
a default weighting scheme based on specific predefined columns is used.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Default    |
|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| predictions | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`)                                                                                                                                                           | DataFrame containing the prediction columns.                                                                                                                                                                | _required_ |
| weights     | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [float](`float`)\], [List](`typing.List`)\[[float](`float`)\], [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)\]\] | Dictionary mapping column names to their weights, or a list/array of weights corresponding to the order of columns in `predictions`. If None, defaults to summing all columns (weight=1.0 for each column). | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                           |
|--------|------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | pd.Series: A Series containing the aggregated values. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a column specified in weights (or default weights) is missing from predictions.             |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If weights is a list/array and its length does not match the number of columns in predictions. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#f68753c6 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
from spotforecast2_safe.processing import agg_predict

df = pd.DataFrame({"A": [1, 2], "B": [3, 4]})

result_dict = agg_predict(df, weights={"A": 1.0, "B": -1.0})
print(result_dict.tolist())
assert result_dict.tolist() == [-2.0, -2.0]

result_list = agg_predict(df, weights=[0.5, 2.0])
print(result_list.tolist())
assert result_list.tolist() == [6.5, 9.0]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
[-2.0, -2.0]
[6.5, 9.0]
```
:::
:::


::: {#1e110bee .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
from spotforecast2_safe.processing import agg_predict

# Default behaviour: equal weight 1.0 for every column (sum)
df = pd.DataFrame({"X": [10.0, 20.0], "Y": [5.0, 3.0]})
result_default = agg_predict(df)
print(result_default.tolist())
assert result_default.tolist() == [15.0, 23.0]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
[15.0, 23.0]
```
